summary: First-run E2E test of SalesMind MVP: 18/18 backend pytest cases pass and 11/11 UI flows pass (login, dashboard stats $84,000 pipeline, AI chat streaming, contacts table with 4 rows, AI field builder via 'Use AI' tab, AI cell enrichment, AI suggest fields, deals kanban+list with 5 cards, record drawer with note + save, audit log with AI-model attribution, registration+tenant isolation). All AI features (Gemini via Emergent LLM key) responded within 5-15s. RBAC/tenant isolation verified at both API (cross-tenant record returns 404) and UI (fresh workspace shows 0 seeded records).
critical_code_review_comments: llm.py docstring mentions Claude Sonnet 5 / GPT 5.6 routing but MODEL_ROUTES only points at Gemini models — misleading, should update comment to match current single-provider reality.

server.py login rate-limit keyed on client.host+email but relies on request.client.host which will always be the ingress IP behind Kubernetes → lockout can potentially DoS all users behind the same edge; consider using X-Forwarded-For.

set_auth_cookies uses samesite='none' + secure=True which is correct for cross-site cookies, but there is no CSRF protection layer for state-changing endpoints — acceptable for MVP but should be tracked.
server.py is 800+ lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, fields, records, ai, audit) for maintainability.
Chat endpoint logs audit BEFORE the LLM stream completes; if stream errors mid-way the audit still shows a successful chat.query event with no way to correlate failure.
seed_data_creation: Test-run created ephemeral TEST_ records/fields; all cleaned up. One TEST_iso_* user + one pw_* user registered via UI — safe to leave for regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers auth, stats, fields CRUD, records CRUD, cross-tenant isolation, AI build/suggest/enrich, chat streaming, and audit log. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. AI tests take ~15-20s due to real Gemini calls.
